description: Calculate the molecular adsorption energy of H2O on the TiO2(110) surface.
user_prompt: Calculate the molecular adsorption energy of intact H2O on the stoichiometric TiO2(110) rutile surface (P4_2/mnm) at a fivefold-coordinated Ti site. Report the final adsorption energy Eads (in eV), defined as Eads = E(slab+H2O) - E(slab) - E(H2O).
